name: GTÜ Formlar
description: Gebze Teknik Üniversitesi'nin bütün resmî dokümanları — formlar, iş akışları, talimatlar, yönergeler — siz ve ajanınızın paylaştığı tek bir arama çubuğunda. Hangi dokümanı aradığınızı bilmeseniz de olur: ne yapmak istediğinizi yazın.
about: A search surface over every document Gebze Technical University publishes in its quality system — 1850 of them: forms, workflows, device and laboratory instructions, directives, regulations, policies, surveys and guides, in Turkish and English. Retrieval is hybrid: an exact document code (FR-0083, İA-0432, CH-TL-0001) wins outright, and everything else is title coverage fused with BM25 and dense multilingual embeddings, so "danışman değiştirmek istiyorum" finds the advisor-change form without naming it. Turkish gets what it needs — İ folds correctly, words are indexed with their stems, and titles the university wrote without diacritics still match queries that have them. The point is the second surface: every search, every opened document and every saved item is a CLI verb AND a control in the window, over one shared state — the agent's `gturag search staj` types itself into the search bar and fills the results, and what you open by hand rides along on your next prompt so you can just ask "bunu nasıl dolduracağım?". The app retrieves; the agent reads and answers. No model runs on a server: the index ships inside the app and the embedder's weights are downloaded once, on first run, into the app's own data directory.

commands.name: search
commands.about: search the GTÜ forms — plain Turkish or English, or a form code like FR-0083; the results fill the window as well as your terminal

commands.name: open
commands.about: open one form (title, code, revision, source URL, matching passages) and show it in the window

commands.name: get
commands.about: print one form's full text, so its fields can be answered on rather than guessed at

commands.name: saved
commands.about: print the shared saved list — the forms collected for the task at hand

commands.name: save
commands.about: add a form to the shared saved list

commands.name: unsave
commands.about: remove a form from the shared saved list

commands.name: sort
commands.about: re-sort the current results by relevance, form code or title — in both surfaces

commands.name: status
commands.about: what both surfaces are looking at: query, results, open form, saved list, index and model state, agents

commands.name: sync
commands.about: check for a newer corpus index and download it; also retries a provisioning step that failed
